Step 3. Gather necessary restraint tools (muzzle, leash, blanket) (5 minutes)
Step 4. Prepare the examination table or floor space (1 minute)
Step 5. Gently guide the dog to the designated restraint area (1 minute)
Step 6. Position the dog on the prepared surface (30 seconds)
Step 7. Reward the dog with praise and a small treat (1 minute)
Step 8. Maintain a gentle but firm physical restraint hold (5 minutes)
